summary: EMQX is an open-source MQTT message broker designed to handle large-scale connections from Internet of Things devices. It facilitates real-time data ingestion and message routing across distributed server clusters.
goodFor: Deploying in industrial or enterprise environments that need to manage millions of concurrent MQTT client connections and high message throughput.
watchOut: Running large Erlang-based clusters requires deep expertise in distributed systems tuning, memory management, and network troubleshooting under high loads.
deployNotes: You can deploy it using Docker containers, and you will typically need to configure persistent storage for retained messages as well as a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination for client connections.
